PLD 2010 Lahore 100
IN THE HIGH COURT OF LAHORE AT LAHORE
Before Example Judge, J
Civil Appeal No. 50 of 2009
Ali Khan versus Province of Punjab
JUDGMENT
EXAMPLE JUDGE, J. The learned counsel appearing for the appellant advanced lengthy arguments touching the merits of the dispute. The respondent for its part maintained that the trial court had correctly appreciated the evidence on record. After hearing the parties we find that the questions raised are substantial and require detailed examination of the entire record. The contentions advanced for the petitioner were considered along with the objections raised by the department. The record shows that the appellant filed the suit for recovery of damages and the trial court decreed the suit in part. The appellate court modified the decree and the present appeal challenges that modification. We have perused the evidence led by both sides and the impugned judgments suffer from no misreading. The appeal is dismissed with no order as to costs.
